name: Orbit ring steps
what: A thin ring around a main text with a glowing dot that waits at one step, swings to the next and stops again; each step has its name outside the ring, shown while the dot is there. It loops without a seam.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f0 the dot waits at step 1 with its name shown; it swings to the next step every 80 f (f1-f81, f81-f161, f161-f241, f241-f321: a very steep S-curve, the fast part at f41 / f121 / f201 / f281, a long soft stop); the name it leaves fades out (f37-f46) and the next fades in (f41-f55); after the fourth swing it is back at step 1, so the 320 f loop without a seam

tracks.name: dot swing
tracks.what: the glowing dot swings along the ring to the next step (repeats every 80 f)
tracks.easing: cubic-bezier(0.778, 0.01, 0.207, 1) (measured): slow start, fast in the middle, long soft stop

tracks.name: name leaves
tracks.what: the name of the step the dot leaves fades out

tracks.name: name arrives
tracks.what: the name of the next step fades in (with its little arrows)

tracks.name: loop
tracks.what: the fourth swing brings the dot back to step 1 and its name
